name: rustic
description: In the reviewed rustic snapshot, self-update is compiled behind the self-update feature; enabled builds configure the rustic GitHub backend and call its release.update method, while builds without the feature report that package-manager updating is required. Verification performed inside the delegated dependency is unresolved.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than the original study release; delegated self_update verification behavior and release-specific controls were not inspected.
